decisions.what: Replaced existing dark-themed #story section with new alternating image-text layout
decisions.why: Spec required py-24 bg-white classes, 'Our Story' h2, two article subsections with Unsplash lifestyle images, and descriptive copy — entirely different from the existing dark-themed story section

decisions.what: Added aria-labelledby to new story section pointing to h2#story-heading
decisions.why: Semantic HTML best practice consistent with all other sections on the page; spec requires semantic HTML

decisions.what: Used data-skeleton attribute on skeleton divs in story images
decisions.why: Matches the gallery section pattern so hideSkeleton/showSkeletonError handlers in app.js work correctly via container.querySelector('[data-skeleton]')

decisions.what: Extended querySelectorAll selector in app.js from '#gallery img' to '#gallery img, #story img'
decisions.why: Spec required extending the handler to cover brand story images without duplicating code; compound selector is the minimal change
